data.one_liner: Provides BLoCs to descendant widgets with internal disposal and RxDart stream builders.
data.what_it_does: Provides BLoC instances to descendant widgets in O(1) time and automatically disposes them when unmounted using an internal state holder. It also includes an RxDart-compatible stream builder widget.
use_when: You are building BLoCs using RxDart and need an efficient widget-tree provider and stream builder.
You want automatic disposal of BLoC instances tied to the provider's lifecycle.
avoid_when: you are using the official `flutter_bloc` package instead of custom RxDart BLoCs.
you prefer a modern state management solution like Riverpod.
strengths: O(1) BLoC lookup via context extension or BlocProvider
Built-in RxStreamBuilder support for handling streams and value streams
weaknesses: Tied specifically to RxDart-based BLoC patterns rather than the official bloc library
Limited ecosystem compared to official bloc or riverpod

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official and widely adopted package for the Bloc pattern.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Modern, compile-safe dependency injection and state management solution.
